name: A11 Global Backdoor
description: Obfuscated global injection starting with global.i="A11-#". A confirmed supply-chain attack pattern found in the wild.

name: Obfuscated eval(atob())
description: Decodes a base64 string at runtime and executes it. Classic payload delivery mechanism.

name: Obfuscated eval(Buffer.from())
description: Node.js equivalent of eval(atob()). Decodes a base64 or hex buffer and executes it.

name: Env Variable Exfiltration (fetch)
description: Sends process.env contents to an external server using the fetch API.

name: Long Hex-Encoded Blob
description: Suspiciously long sequence of hex escape sequences. Often used to hide malicious code from static analysis.
